signed_rows.behavior: A concept verified on a branch is not due after the branch lands by squash merge, rebase merge or merge commit when nothing changed after the verification.
signed_rows.fails_when: review due lists the concept after any of the three landings

signed_rows.behavior: A concept is due 'source changed' when a commit after its verification commit changes one of its sources.
signed_rows.fails_when: the concept is not listed with source changed naming that source

signed_rows.behavior: A concept is due 'edited after verification' when a commit after its verification commit changes its body or a front matter field other than verified and stale_after.
signed_rows.fails_when: the concept is not listed with that reason, for a body edit or for a description edit

signed_rows.behavior: A commit that only adds a verified entry, with or without --stale-after, leaves the concept off the list; an uncommitted verified entry counts nothing as changed after it.
signed_rows.fails_when: the concept is listed after a verify-only commit, with or without stale_after

signed_rows.behavior: A docs page follows the same two rules, and one without verified uses its own last commit as the baseline, by commit not date.
signed_rows.fails_when: a docs page gets a different answer than a concept in the same case, or the unverified baseline compares dates

signed_rows.behavior: The batched history walk picks the same verification commit as a per-file git log, including across a merge and a rename.
signed_rows.fails_when: the batched and per-file walks pick different commits for any file in the test repository

signed_rows.behavior: The existing review due tests still pass.

A new decision records that review due decides by commit order and names the new reason; ADR 0006 and ADR 0023 carry dated corrections pointing to it; the module docstring, the review due help, docs/reference/commands.md and the docs-layout rule say the same.
signed_rows.fails_when: the decision or a correction is missing, or any of those surfaces still describes comparing dates

accepted_risks.reason: Commit order with no new field; a verify-then-edit inside one squashed branch is missed, which keeps kmctl on OKF's own fields (ADR 0006, I4)
